title: vektor /// no. 060 · The PDF goes in as Markdown.
description: Anthropic's docs say a PDF goes into Claude twice per page: once as text, once as a picture. Microsoft's MarkItDown converts it to Markdown first. The install line, the command, and Auto-Markdown for Claude Code: a tested hook that converts PDFs automatically, with fallbacks for scans and chart-heavy files.
